title: Real Evia autoplay walkthrough
details: Show me around now uses Evia's real home layout, course-route structure, task rows and progress arches
The walkthrough no longer invents Practical evidence or Knowledge evidence route pages
The walkthrough now auto-plays from start to finish and does not require the learner to press through the tour
Photo, Video, Written and guided Audio evidence are all demonstrated inside the walkthrough
Walkthrough guidance stays in one fixed text area above the bottom controls instead of moving speech bubbles
Evia behaves like the real app by moving from the home position to the open-menu position rather than floating around as a second avatar
Course coverage, assessor QR exchange, Learn, Mock Practical, Maths Level 2 and English Level 2 remain demonstrated
The existing demo limits, QR activation, learner evidence, targets and Naxos course-pack behaviour are unchanged
summary: Evia v221 makes Show me around match the real learner interface and turns it into a fully automatic professional walkthrough of the actual evidence journey.
changes: Replaced the v218/v219 walkthrough runtime with a single v221 real-layout walkthrough
Added automatic Photo, Video, Written and guided Audio demonstrations
Removed required walkthrough taps and moving speech bubbles
Added a fixed guidance text position and fresh v221 offline cache
